letters.name: Alif
letters.tip: Open the mouth naturally; sound originates from empty mouth space.

letters.name: Ba
letters.tip: Press both inner lips firmly together.

letters.name: Ta
letters.tip: Touch the tip of the tongue to the roots of the upper front teeth.

letters.name: Tha
letters.tip: Lightly touch the tip of the tongue to the edge of the upper front teeth.

letters.name: Jeem
letters.tip: Press the middle of the tongue firmly against the roof of the mouth.

letters.name: Haa
letters.tip: Exhale from the middle of the throat with a warm breath.

letters.name: Khaa
letters.tip: Gargle the sound slightly from the top of the throat.

letters.name: Dal
letters.tip: Touch the tip of the tongue to the roots of the upper teeth, similar to Ta.

letters.name: Dhal
letters.tip: Lightly touch the tip of the tongue to the edge of the upper teeth, similar to Tha.

letters.name: Ra
letters.tip: Tap the tip of the tongue gently against the gum line with a slight trill.

letters.name: Zay
letters.tip: Bring teeth close together and let air whistle across the tip of the tongue.

letters.name: Seen
letters.tip: Direct a sharp whistling breath over the tip of the tongue behind lower teeth.

letters.name: Sheen
letters.tip: Spread the middle of the tongue against the palate with a spreading breath.

letters.name: Sad
letters.tip: Pronounce 'S' while elevating and hollowing the back of the tongue for a heavy sound.

letters.name: Dad
letters.tip: Press the side of the tongue against the upper molars.

letters.name: Taa
letters.tip: Pronounce 'T' while elevating the back of the tongue to make it heavy.

letters.name: Zhaa
letters.tip: Lightly touch the tip of the tongue to the upper teeth with a heavy, full mouth.

letters.name: Ayn
letters.tip: Squeeze the middle of the throat tightly from deep within.

letters.name: Ghayn
letters.tip: Gargle softly from the top of the throat with a heavy resonance.

letters.name: Fa
letters.tip: Touch the edge of the upper front teeth to the inside of the lower lip.

letters.name: Qaf
letters.tip: Pull the extreme back of the tongue up to the soft palate.

letters.name: Kaf
letters.tip: Touch the back of the tongue to the hard and soft palate junction.

letters.name: Lam
letters.tip: Press the edges of the tongue tip against the gums of the upper teeth.

letters.name: Meem
letters.tip: Close the lips completely while generating a nasal sound (Ghunnah).

letters.name: Noon
letters.tip: Touch the tip of the tongue to the gum line behind upper teeth with a nasal hum.

letters.name: Waw
letters.tip: Round the lips forward without letting them fully close.

letters.name: Haa_end
letters.tip: Release breath smoothly from the deepest part of the throat.

letters.name: Ya
letters.tip: Raise the middle of the tongue toward the roof of the mouth.
